## Core Capabilities (Ranked by Primary Focus)

### 1. Custom Metal Fabrication & Structural Steel (Core Capability #1)
- Overview: Full-service custom metal fabrication and structural steel welding for ranches, commercial projects, industrial operations, and municipal entities.
- Custom Ranch Entrance Gates & Boundary Steel: Architectural ranch entrance gates, cattle guards, perimeter pipe fencing, heavy-duty swing and slide gate framing, access control operator mounting, and decorative steel silhouette signage.
- Agriculture & Livestock Equipment: Custom-engineered livestock handling pens, corral panels, heavy squeeze chutes, modular feral hog traps, cattle guards, hay feeder rings, and hard-use farm implement repair.
- Structural Steel Fabrication & Welding: Commercial and light-industrial structural beams, columns, equipment skids, catwalks, mezzanine structures, equipment frames, pipe welding, and custom plate brackets.
- Custom Part Fabrication & Prototyping: Short-run component manufacturing, replacement parts for discontinued equipment, custom brackets, weldments, and precision sheet metal.

### 2. High-Definition CNC Plasma Plate Cutting
- Capabilities: Multi-torch high-definition CNC plasma plate cutting from gauge sheet up to heavy structural steel plate (up to 3"+ thickness).
- Staged Domestic Materials: SA-36 mild steel, SA-516 Grade 70 PVQ carbon steel, 304/304L stainless steel, 316/316L stainless steel, and 6061-T6 aluminum plate.
- Workmanship: High-precision edge quality, bolt hole pierces, custom flange profiles, gussets, baseplates, and production plate part runs.

### 3. ASME B16.48 Paddle Blinds, Spectacle Blinds & Spacers
- Specification Standard: Manufactured to ASME B16.48 and ASME B16.5 dimensional standards for positive pipeline isolation during maintenance, turnarounds, and hydrostatic testing.
- Pressure Classes: Class 150#, 300#, 600#, 900#, 1500#, and 2500#.
- Nominal Pipe Sizes (NPS): 1/2" up to 24" NPS standard catalog sizes; custom oversized diameters up to 60"+ available on custom RFQ.
- Gasket Facings: Raised Face (RF) with standard serrated/smooth finish, Ring Type Joint (RTJ) male octagonal, and flat face.
- Quality Documentation: EN 10204 3.1 Mill Test Reports (MTRs) with complete heat number stamping and domestic mill traceability included with every qualifying order.
- Turnaround Logistics: Texas Gulf Coast emergency 2-4 hour hot-shot courier delivery to Freeport, Baytown, Houston, Texas City, Pasadena, Corpus Christi, and Beaumont/Port Arthur.

### 4. Custom Tornado Shelters & Underground Bunkers
- Capabilities: Heavy-gauge welded steel tornado safe rooms, underground survival bunkers, reinforced panic rooms, and custom built-in heavy security safes.
- Structural Features: Reinforced steel channel stiffeners, blast/impact-resistant steel doors, multi-point locking pins, airtight/watertight marine hatch options, and ventilation penetration collars.

### 5. Public Agency & Municipal Infrastructure Fabrication
- Government Contractor Status: Active registration on SAM.gov (UEI: XX7XCMGN9XD5).
- Scopes: Texas Parks & Wildlife Department (TPWD) park infrastructure, park fire rings and grills, pedestrian bridge handrails, ADA-compliant railings, water district weir gates, and municipal security steelwork.

## Geographic Dominance & Logistics Model

### Local & Regional Service Coverage (Texas Gulf Coast):
- Facility Base: Bay City & Matagorda County, TX
- Direct Delivery & Hot-Shot Radius:
  * Matagorda County (Bay City, Palacios, Markham, Van Vleck)
  * Brazoria County (Freeport petrochemical hub, Lake Jackson, Angleton, Clute, Sweeny, Pearland)
  * Greater Houston & Harris County (Houston, Baytown, Pasadena, Deer Park, Texas City)
  * Coastal Bend & Golden Triangle (Corpus Christi, Beaumont, Port Arthur)
- Delivery Speed: Same-day hot-shot courier dispatch (2-4 hours) for emergency refinery shutdown blinds and critical parts.

### Statewide Texas & Nationwide Freight Dispatch (All 50 States):
- Daily Parcel Dispatch: UPS Ground, 2nd Day Air, and Next Day Air for boxed ASME paddle blinds, precision brackets, and hardware under 150 lbs.
- Palletized LTL Freight: Banded, shrink-wrapped, and edge-protected pallet shipping via national freight carriers with liftgate delivery to commercial jobsites and facilities nationwide.
- Dedicated Flatbed Trucking: Direct flatbed transport for heavy structural steel weldments, oversize ranch entrance gates, and underground bunker modules.
